## Reading

The LD-consistency screen is the load-bearing step. Cancellation (`sum(beta^2)/h2`) falls from ~271 to ~0.65 and the divergence warning clears. Above the limit of 10 the effects are cancelling through LD rather than adding, so the `rg` reported at the first two stages is not an estimate of anything.

## Cross-platform comparison

| stage | macos-arm64 (0.3.5) | win-x86_64 (0.3.6) | delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| harmonised | +0.0558 | +0.0558 | +0.0000 |
| per-variant QC | +0.1390 | +0.1390 | +0.0000 |
| + LD-consistency screen | +0.2856 | +0.2658 | +0.0198 |

Stages 1 and 2 agree to every recorded digit across a different OS, architecture, BLAS and an independently rebuilt LD reference. Stage 3 differs because bipred 0.3.6 reseeded the screening masks, which moves 200 of ~845,000 variants. That is a deliberate change, but it is also a biological estimate shifting under an implementation refactor -- the reason this lives in `studies/` rather than `benchmarks/`.
